title: Neurable
summary: Boston company building non-invasive neural interfaces that read attention from ordinary headphones.
bodyHtml:
Neurable develops dry-electrode EEG systems embedded in headphones, branded MW75 Neuro, that estimate attention and cognitive load without gel or a lab.

The company targets productivity and research use cases rather than medical implants.

Why it matters

  • Dry-electrode EEG
  • Attention and load estimation
  • Consumer headphone form factor

businessMeaning: Non-invasive BCIs avoid surgery but capture noisier signals. A useful product must work with three electrodes and real-world motion.
investmentLens: Private; a consumer-device bet with a much lower regulatory burden than implants.
